metas.name: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
metas.description: After his classmate and crush is diagnosed with a pancreatic disease, an average high schooler sets out to make the most of her final days.

metas.name: The Garden of Words
metas.description: Takao, who is training to become a shoemaker, skipped school and is sketching shoes in a Japanese-style garden. He meets a mysterious woman, Yukino, who is older than him. Then, without arranging the times, the two start to see each other again and again, but only on rainy days. They deepen their relationship and open up to each other. But the end of the rainy season soon approaches.

metas.name: Futurama: The Beast with a Billion Backs
metas.description: Fresh off ripping space-time a new one at the end of "Bender's Big Score," the Planet Express crew is back to mend the tear in reality, or (hopefully) at least not make it worse.  Beyond the tear, though, lurks a being of inconceivable...tentacularity.  What will become of Earth, and indeed, our universe, when faced with the Beast with a Billion Backs?
